snippet.title: KILLSWITCH CLIMAX - First Trailer
snippet.description:
This is the trailer for my cyberpunk indie game about cyborg girls and the future of humanity, inspired by Helltaker and VA-11 Hall-A.
Everything you see here has been made by myself.

Hack your enemies and save the future from a tall motherly robot who has dominated all of humanity!

Wishlist now on steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3745570/KILLSWITCH_CLIMAX/
Follow the development:
https://x.com/Cugu00
